mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 49 degrees with light drizzle over Badger Prairie County Park. You can also spot the space station tonight at 5:43 PM, as it rises over Belleville and travels toward Fitchburg for a three-minute pass.
The city has released election candidate packets for the 2027 spring election, and public works is hosting a meeting regarding the Military Ridge State Trail paving project this December.
We have a busy couple of days ahead with live music at Paddy Mac and yoga at Insight Wellness happening today, plus trivia at The Mill and The Bogey Factory tomorrow.
On October 23, two 13-year-olds were contacted by officers for riding electric motorcycles, resulting in citations for their parents.
Our flavor of the day is the delightful Chocolate Caramel Twist, and since we are open until 10 PM, there is plenty of time to stop by for a scoop.
